statement: Each applicable company (every Hong Kong-incorporated company other than a listed company) must keep a significant controllers register, in English or Chinese, even if the company has no significant controller (Companies Ordinance section 653H, in Division 2A of Part 12 as introduced by the Companies (Amendment) Ordinance 2018 in operation from 1 March 2018).
caveat: Section 653I prescribes the register's contents (Schedule 5B particulars), the register is kept for law-enforcement inspection rather than public search, and the company must also designate a representative to provide register assistance. Breach is an offence with a level 4 fine and daily default fines.
